summary.en-US: Switch proxy profiles in one click. Keep page-visible location, timezone and WebRTC settings together, with clear identity diagnostics. For Firefox desktop.

version.approval_notes:
Reviewer details are in docs/AMO-REVIEW.md and docs/PRIVACY.md in the exact tagged source. This candidate changes runtime behavior from published 1.1.5: bilingual quick setup, isolated automatic draft preview, Save and enable, remembered visible-map loading and new-profile protection defaults. No new permission or runtime dependency.

Firefox desktop >=140. Schema 4 stores profiles/applied route without usernames/passwords; credentials are session-only unless the optional master-password vault is enabled. Native WebCrypto AES-GCM/PBKDF2-SHA256 then encrypts profiles and saved/applied credentials; the derived key is session-only. Encrypted backup and empty-install restore are supported. See docs/ENCRYPTED-VAULT.md. Required locationInfo/authenticationInfo and optional personallyIdentifyingInfo remain declared. Save is non-activating; Save and enable saves the current visible form then activates it. Existing saved policies are preserved. New proxy profiles use proxy-only WebRTC, automatic identity and SOCKS DNS by default.

Typing a valid endpoint in an open setup editor automatically contacts ipwho.is through that draft proxy after a short pause, before Save/enable. Only the marked extension request uses the draft; ordinary traffic retains its active route. Consent, request-owner binding, terminal-null routing, no redirects/cookies/referrer, 12-second/64-KiB/four-job limits, cancellation and stale-result suppression apply. No retry loop or durable draft credentials. Options GeoIP Disabled suppresses checks.

The map starts offline. First explicit enablement remembers a boolean automatic-loading preference. Later visible-map openings obtain fresh generation/route-bound authorization; they cannot raise a consent prompt automatically. Unload/unchecking clears the preference. OpenFreeMap/CDN sees egress IP and viewed region. Direct/Off requires optional IP consent; unsafe routes, missing credentials and provider bypasses deny loading. Coordinates work offline.

MapLibre 6.11.2 code/CSS/worker/notices are bundled. Source hashes and a full external-worker-plugin denial transform are verified during build. No remote executable code. The map broker validates HTTPS resources, rejects redirects, omits cookies/referrers/explicit proxy credentials and cancels stale sessions. Renderer queue is bounded.

Selected proxies never silently fall back to Direct for ordinary observed traffic. Missing required credentials block ordinary traffic; Firefox-protected services cannot all be canceled. Servers must reject anonymous clients for account identity. Passive health does not replay requests or guarantee recovery time. This is not a universal kill switch.

Screenshots use local synthetic fixtures. Final publication requires exact-version AMO approval, unchanged signed-XPI payload/hash verification and permanent signature-enforcing stable Firefox installation.
